changeSet.author: s-soja
changeSet.sql: UPDATE delivery d SET current_department_id = COALESCE( (SELECT step.department_id FROM delivery_step step WHERE step.delivery_id = d.id AND step.department_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY step.step_number DESC LIMIT 1), d.origin_department_id)

changeSet.author: s-soja
changeSet.sql: UPDATE shipment_rd rd SET current_department_id = current_delivery.current_department_id FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) target_id, current_department_id FROM delivery WHERE target_type = 'SHIPMENT' AND delivery_type = 'OUTBOUND' AND status <> 'CANCELED' ORDER BY target_id, created DESC) current_delivery WHERE CAST(rd.shipment_id AS VARCHAR(255)) = current_delivery.target_id
